header_sentences: See Present Church; and see Church, and New Church.

contexts.text: In  it treats (also) of the destruction of the Old Church, which is signified by Sodom and Gomorrah...
When the Old Church expires and becomes night, a new one always rises again elsewhere.
When a new Church is being instaurated... this takes place rarely, if ever, with those with whom the Old Church has been... Example(s).
It is always provided... that when the Old Church perishes a new one is instaurated.
The instauration of a new Church takes place when the Old Church is vastated and rejected. Treated of.
When the end of the Old Church and the beginning of the new one is at land, there is then the Last Judgment.
Then is the consummation of the age, that is, the Last Judgment, and the Advent of the Lord; consequently then is the Old Church being rejected, and the new one being instaurated.
That the internals and externals of the Former Church will perish; but that the Word of the Lord will remain. Signified.
When the Church is being instaurated with the gentiles, and the Former, or Old Church is falling from charity and faith. Signified.

These words describe what the state will be when the Old Church is being rejected, and the new one is being instaurated. The rejection of the Old Church and the instauration of the new one is meant by the consummation of the age, and by the Advent of the Son of Man, and, in general, by the Last Judgment.

How the case is with the rejection of an Old Church... scarcely anyone knows. He who is not acquainted with the interiors of man, and the states of these interiors... cannot apprehend otherwise than that those who are of the Old Church, with whom good and truth has been vastated... will perish, either, like the antediluvians, by a flood, or like the Jews, by being driven out from their land, or otherwise. But the Church, when it has been vastated principally perishes as to the states of (its members') interiors, thus as to the states in the other life. Heaven then removes itself from them, and consequently the Lord; and transfers itself to others, who are adopted in their place.

At that time, those who are of the Old Church, and thus removed from Heaven, are in a certain inundation as to the interiors, and indeed in an inundation above the head. This inundation is not apperceived by the man himself while he lives in the body, but he comes into it after death. In the other life this inundation manifestly appears, and indeed like a foggy mist by which they are encompassed, and thereby separated from Heaven. The state of those who are in this foggy mist, is that they cannot possibly see what the truth of faith, and still less what its good is; for the light of Heaven... cannot penetrate into that mist. This is the state of a vastated Church.
Those who are within a vastated Church are almost all such; they have externals, but no internals; hence the inundation of their interiors. Signified.
The last time of the Old Church, and the first of the new one. Signified. AC 6000:4. AC 6000. AC 6588. AC 6895:2. AC 7844:3.
The Advent of the Lord = ... the denial of truth Divine by those who are of the Old Church.
The land = the Old Church.
To join the truth of the New Church to the truth of the Old Church, is to destroy both. Signified. (Continued. See New Church.)
The barren = the gentiles who are summoned to the Church... when the Old Church has ceased; that is, when those who had previously been of the Church are no longer in faith, because in no charity.
There is also a new state when an Old Church is ceasing, and a new one is beginning.
For the Old Church has arrived at its end...
The consummation of the age = the last state of the Old Church; the Advent of the Lord, the first state of the New one. AR 53:2.
The old wine = the Divine truth of the Old Testament, thus of the Old Church.
The falsities of the Former Church are first to be removed. (Continued. See New Church.)
The falsities of the Former Church fighting against the truths of the New Church. Signified, Explained.
The combat between the Old Church and the New one. Signified.
That there shall then be nothing of doctrine in the Old Church, and that therefore people will flee from it. Signified.
The evening the morning = the end of the Old Church when there is a New one.
That the faith of the New Church cannot possibly be together with the faith of the Former Church... General article. TCR 647.

(Thus) those who have confirmed with themselves the faith of the Old Church cannot except with danger to their spiritual life embrace the faith of the New Church, unless they have first... extirpated the former faith... BE 104.
This error... has perverted the whole Church, so that not anything spiritual is left in it. General article.
From (the imputation of the Lord's merit) have sprung all the dogmas of the Former Church.
The tares = the falsities and evils of the Former Church](which must be removed before the New Jerusalem can descend.)
(Luther) perceived that at this day it is the end of the Former Church...
a. The gentiles could not enter into the congregation of the Old Church, still less found a new one separated from the Old, before the Advent of the Messiah into the world...
In Laban were represented the gentiles; in Rebekah the New Church; and in the mother of both the Old Church.
The Old Church (Esau) was prior in time; the new Church (Jacob) posterior in time...
Insignia and symbols of both the Old Church and of the new Church.
Leah represents that representative and typical Church, which is called the Old Church; but Rachel the Christian Church itself.
Preface. The style of the Old Church was such that...
Hence the music of the Old Church.
To the last time of the Old Church, and the first of the New...
The old wine = the truth of the Old or Jewish Church...
For at the time of the Last Judgment the Old Church is perishing...
Even to the end of the Old Church... Signified, Explained. AE 636.
The devastation of the Old Church or Most Ancient Church. Signified.

Three days and a half = the end of the Old Church, when they will not receive anything whatever of the good of love and the truth of doctrine... The end of the Former Church is signified by that the beast which ascendeth out of the abyss shall kill those witnesses... AE 658:2. AE 664.
Here is described the state of those who are against the goods of love and the truths of doctrine, when it is the end of the Old Church and the beginning of the New...
This even until the Old Church has arrived at its last...
Because the Former Church has become a desert.
See New Jerusalem (concerning the good in the Old Church).
Harvest = the last state of the Church, when the Old Church has been devastated...
For the end of this Church is coming...
Trinity. 3. 5. This age of the Old Church...
It follows that in that Church there does not remain a grain of truth; thus that it is the abomination of desolation.
